notes.title: Patch 1.8 Notes
notes.content:
The Save as You Go Patch

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030335/b2e8e92a0cad2293724cec16af43a2fe0a0a0a28.jpg

Patch Notes:

- Auto Saving
- Removed Linear Gameplay
- New Custom Controllers!
- Main Menu effects update

 Save Your Progress 
Once you complete a Puzzle you do not have to do it again to reach the final level. Next time you open the game it will be reset to allow you to play it again if you wish, but you do not have to.

 Do Puzzles in Any Order 
You are no longer restricted to a certain order to complete puzzles. Do them in any order you wish, but the last and final puzzle will not be able to be entered into until you have completed each puzzle before it at least once before.

notes.title: Patch 1.4 Notes
notes.content:
Welcome to the Monkey Monk patch! 

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030335/4720f236152690b7f9bfc376ac4ed035caf76c4a.jpg

Now when you go up to a Monkey, if they are pleased with your work, or are ready for you to help them, they will smile at you.

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27030335/4013eb039781424b220d8446c6cecfaf2a9409b1.jpg

If they are not ready for you to help them, they will frown and wave their hands to stop you.

Patch Notes:

- Added in Monkey Monk expressions to help guide players
- Optimized getting Monkey attention when you are ready to help them
- Fixed many sound and music issues
- Sped up the text in the loading screen


Thanks again to all those who are helping us to improve our game by leaving feedback. We look forward to hearing from you!

notes.title: Patch 1.0 Notes
notes.content:
This patch will remove most problems associated with movement and other game breaking bugs. 

- Fixed controller manipulation to remove single controller rotation.
- Stopped spinning walls in last two puzzles
- General optimizations - removed logging
- Fixed mirror maze repeat animation
- Optimized loading screen


Thank you to everyone who played our game and those who left great feedback! We are constantly working to make Broken Blue a better experience so keep checking back!
